data.one_liner: A Flutter carousel slider widget with infinite scroll, autoplay and enlarge mode.
data.what_it_does: Provides a CarouselSlider widget that can scroll infinitely, autoplay slides, and enlarge the center page. It supports drag gestures from all pointer device kinds and offers simple configuration via CarouselOptions.
use_when: You need a simple carousel/slider for images or content lists
You want built‑in infinite scrolling and autoplay without extra packages
avoid_when: You require highly custom animations or fine‑grained playback control
You need features that were removed (e.g., pause on touch, separate controller start/stop)
strengths: Supports infinite scroll, autoplay, and center‑page enlargement
weaknesses: Limited customization compared to more feature‑rich carousel libraries
Removed some control APIs may limit advanced use cases
data.minimal_example:
CarouselSlider(
  options: const CarouselOptions(height: 400),
  items: [1,2,3,4,5].map((i) => Container(
    width: MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width,
    margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8.0),
    decoration: const BoxDecoration(color: Colors.amber),
    child: Text('text $i', style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 16)),
  )).toList(),
)
